source: prototype encounters for day one. The novel describes day one without a battle; these are additions for play testing.
field_notes: text: description shown when the encounter starts.

approaches: which responses exist. combat, persuade, puzzle or summon. Each is offered only if a party member has a skill mapped to it in assets/data/rules/balance.json (approach_skills); combat is always offered.
enemy_hp, enemy_def, enemy_tags: enemy stats and tags. Required when combat, persuade or summon can start a fight. Tags are matched against attack tags through the affinity table.
persuade_threshold: a persuade roll at or above this value succeeds (0 to 1). Default 0.5.
on_loss: food, herbs and injury applied when a fight is lost.

entries.text: 一群怨靈在山路口聚集，低聲重複著某個名字。
路旁的石壁上刻著符文封印，光線流過刻紋後又暗了下去。
